{{Quote|We aren't going to be able to use the preliminary base in Targarth system. We've had positive identification of Imperial probes.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="HAT" />}}
The '''Targarth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Corosi sector/Legends|Corosi sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] intended to set its main base in this system until [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probes]] were spotted in the area.<ref name="HAT">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]''</ref>
